QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] Kurama's Solution
QuestInfo.0: Since Kurama is the reason Izuna's angry, maybe he can fix things? Go talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Kurama has an idea he thinks will make everything better: a vote for the Beauty of the Mushroom Shrine. It sounds a little ridiculous, but Kurama won't take no for an answer.
QuestInfo.2: You told all the guys at the Mushroom Shrine about the vote. Time to find out how it went!
